scheme_name: West Bengal Incentive Scheme for Approved Industrial Park (SAIP) for MSMEs: Incentive for Setting up a Power Sub Station
other_conditions: Applicant must be a private‑sector entity or an existing/operational industrial park
Must have a minimum of 5 acres of legally owned land (by direct purchase or lease from the State Government)
The Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) must be registered under the Companies Act, Societies Registration Act, Partnership Act or LLP Act
Park area must be expanded to at least 5 acres in outlying districts or at least 2 acres in Kolkata and Howrah
All individual units must have obtained necessary clearances for land conversion, fire licence, environmental compliance, building plan, etc.
benefits_summary: Free setup of a power sub‑station for approved industrial parks
